gui.burmaldaholic.baccarat.rules.player: Player draws on 0–5 and stands on 6–7.
gui.burmaldaholic.baccarat.rules.banker_: If Player stood, Banker draws on 0–5 and stands on 6–7.
If Player drew, Banker's move by its total and Player's third card:
3: draws unless the card is an 8
Banker bets go in steps of %1$s so the commission comes out exact.

One player holds the bank and plays the Banker hand; the others bet on Player against the bank.
Bets are accepted until the bank is covered. Banco matches the whole bank alone.
A winning banker may keep the bank. A losing banker passes it on. The house takes %1$s%% of the banker's wins.

gui.burmaldaholic.uth.rules.1: Ante and Blind are required and equal. Trips is optional.
gui.burmaldaholic.uth.rules.2: Before the flop: check or bet ×3 or ×4 the Ante. After the flop: check or bet ×2. After the river: bet ×1 or fold.
gui.burmaldaholic.uth.rules.2_no3x: Before the flop: check or bet ×4 the Ante. After the flop: check or bet ×2. After the river: bet ×1 or fold.
gui.burmaldaholic.uth.rules.3: You make one Play bet per round at most. Your best five of your two cards and the five on the board count.
gui.burmaldaholic.uth.rules.4: The dealer qualifies with a pair or better. If not, the Ante is returned.
gui.burmaldaholic.uth.rules.5: Play and Ante pay 1:1. The Blind pays extra on a win with a straight or better. Trips pays on your hand even if you fold.

dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.demand.1: Evening. We're from the bank. You know why we're here.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.demand.2: %1$s. That's the number. Say it with us.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.demand.3: Nice house. Would be a shame if we had to wait inside it.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.demand.4: The boss says hi. The boss also says pay.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.demand.5: We can do this the easy way, or the other way. We brought equipment for both.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.hostile.2: Okay. The other way it is.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.hostile.4: Running only raises the late fee.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.paid.1: Pleasure doing business. We were never here.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.paid.2: See? Nobody got hurt. Well, your wallet.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.paid.3: Account closed. Have a nice day.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.paid.4: Boss will be pleased. Let's go, boys.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.partial.1: Half now, half later. We'll be back tomorrow.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.partial.2: It's a start. We know where you live.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.partial.3: Good faith payment accepted. Don't make it the last one.
dialog.burmaldaholic.collector.repossess: We'll take that. And that. Thanks for your cooperation.
